hero.title: Built by pet lovers, for pet lovers
hero.subtitle: Pawmie started with a simple idea: every pet deserves attentive, stress-free care — and every pet parent deserves total peace of mind when handing over their furry family member.

values.title: 🐾 Trust above everything
values.description: Every sitter on Pawmie goes through a thorough vetting process — background checks, reference calls, and a trial visit — so you never have to wonder if your pet is in good hands.

values.title: 📸 Radical transparency
values.description: Real-time photo updates, GPS check-ins, and live chat mean you're never out of the loop. Your pet's day should feel as visible to you as it does to us.

values.title: ✨ Effortless booking
values.description: We obsess over removing friction. From finding a sitter to checkout, every screen is designed to feel fast, calm, and clear — even at 11 pm when you've just remembered you need cover.

values.title: 💛 Genuine animal care
values.description: We partner only with sitters who treat pets like their own. Our community guidelines, training resources, and regular check-ins ensure the standard never slips.

story.heading: How Pawmie came to life
paragraphs: It started with Milo — a three-year-old golden retriever who absolutely hated kennels. His owner, Maya, spent weeks calling sitters, getting ghosted, and eventually leaving Milo with a neighbour she barely knew. The anxiety never went away.

Maya and her co-founder Ravi — a software engineer with two cats and a mild obsession with UX — decided there had to be a better way. They spent six months interviewing pet parents, sitters, and vets before writing a single line of code.

The result was Pawmie: a platform designed not just to connect pets and sitters, but to make the entire experience feel warm, reliable, and genuinely human. Today, thousands of pets across 18 cities come home happy every week — and Milo finally loves his sitter visits.

team.name: Maya Chen
team.bio: Former product lead at a pet-health startup, dog mum to Milo, and the person most likely to be found at 7 am testing the booking flow on her phone. Maya drives Pawmie's vision and obsesses over the owner experience.

team.name: Ravi Menon
team.bio: Full-stack engineer turned startup builder. Ravi architected Pawmie's real-time update system and believes that great technology should feel invisible. Cat dad ×2, coffee snob ×1.

team.name: Priya Osei
team.bio: Priya runs sitter onboarding, quality standards, and the support team. With a background in veterinary care and community operations, she's the reason Pawmie's sitter network is consistently rated 4.9 ★.

team.name: Leon Park
team.bio: Leon crafts every screen of the Pawmie experience — from the booking calendar to the live update cards. He believes delightful design is 10% aesthetics and 90% empathy for the person holding the phone at midnight.
